BETA Close X RS Group PLC has purchased 5,280,044 of its ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. These purchases occurred between June 29, 2026, and July 3, 2026, with prices ranging from 580.50 pence to 625.00 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 471,824,424, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 471,824,424 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 06 July 2026 RS Group plc 6 July 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 29 June 2026 to 3 July 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 471,824,424 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury.
